metadata.name: Console UI
metadata.description:
[h1]Console UI[/h1] [b]A self-contained in-game command menu. No external download, PowerShell, or native debug console required.[/b]
Subscribe, enable the Mod, start a run, and press [b]F6[/b] or hold the left stick button (L3) for about 0.5 seconds.
[list] [*]No required dependencies; External Item Descriptions (EID) is optional [*]One subscription supports Repentance, Repentance+, and REPENTOGON without a second edition [*]18 categories with 721 collectibles, 188 trinkets, 97 cards/runes, 50 pill effects, 106 built-in command/reference entries, and Custom Commands [*]Create, name, search, favorite, edit, and delete custom commands with no artificial item-count limit; the complete SaveData keeps its 64 KiB safety gate [*]Mode-aware stage safety lists: 45 Normal/Hard destinations and 7 Greed/Greedier destinations [*]Unified keyboard, mouse, and controller support across Repentance, Repentance+, and REPENTOGON, including focus-aware LT/RT paging [*]On the first menu open of each process, an empty Featured view starts on the first Collectibles entry; D-pad navigation prefers runtime menu actions with raw fallback [*]All 1,162 object and command entries can be favorited; Featured shows the most recent favorites first without changing command permissions [*]F, controller X, and hollow/filled mouse stars toggle favorites; C opens manual commands and Up/Down recalls command history [*]Complete official collectible, trinket, card/rune, and pill-effect catalogs loaded lazily [*]Optional EID en_us descriptions, with ItemConfig fallback [*]Optional Mod Config Menu settings for the keyboard open key, controller favorite key, startup key hint, and whether regular commands close the menu [*]Measured low-resolution layout with mouse, keyboard D, and controller Y paging for long descriptions [*]giveitem and spawn can repeat 1-99 times; unsafe commands remain single-run [*]No key injection, native console popup, network access, or external programs [/list]
[h1]Controls[/h1] 1. Press F6, or hold L3 for about 0.5 seconds, to open the menu. 2. Use the arrow keys, mouse, or D-pad to navigate. 3. Press Enter, left-click, or tap A to execute. 4. Right-click or hold A for about 0.5 seconds to remove a removable collectible or trinket. 5. Press F or controller X to favorite; use LT/RT to page the focused category or entry area, LB/RB to change the repeat count, and Y to page a multi-page description. 6. The Mod overlay hides while the native pause menu is open and restores after resuming.
[b]Removing a collectible is not a full undo.[/b] Coins, keys, bombs, health, spawned entities, room state, and scripted pickup effects may remain after the item itself is removed.
[h1]Language-version conflict[/h1] Console UI and Isaac Chinese Console both use F6 and L3. Install both if you wish, but enable only one language version at a time.
[h1]Safety[/h1] This is a local entertainment, build-testing, and screenshot tool that changes the current run. Do not use it in Daily Challenges or online multiplayer. Back up important saves before testing.
If you report a problem, include the game version, DLC/runtime, enabled Mod list, and relevant log.txt lines.
